assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has recurrent episodes of supraventricular tachycardia
The symptoms are characterized by palpitations
The symptoms are characterized by lightheadedness
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The monitoring was ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
The monitoring was ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate-control therapy
The diagnosis of transient cerebral ischemic attack is coded G45.9
The diagnosis of supraventricular tachycardia is coded I47.1
Prior authorization for this diagnostic procedure is medically necessary
The prior authorization directly supports the clinical indication documented for this service
